title: L3-37
description: L3-37 was a special Droid, self-built from scrap astromech and Protocol Droid parts. She cared deeply about the rights of her fellow Droids and herself, though she still palled around with Lando Calrisian, despite her tendency to be off-putting to organics for speaking her mind. Her ability to communicate directly with the Millennium Falcon made her a valuable asset to the smuggler.
